# [TASK] Wire up SonarQube in CI + a real JaCoCo coverage threshold

## Task
DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md lists "Static analysis (SonarQube) clean" and "Test coverage meets the project threshold" as gates, but neither is enforced. `sonar.host.url` defaults to `localhost:9010` with no `SONAR_TOKEN` in any workflow, so `sonar` never runs in CI. No `jacocoTestCoverageVerification` rule exists, so the coverage threshold isn't checked either.

## Scope
Backend only (mirrors #101's split). Frontend coverage is tracked separately — see the new Task this Story picks up for that.

The coverage rule belongs in the **root** `build.gradle`'s shared `jacoco {}` block (already applied to every subproject — see `sonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths` aggregating `backend/**/build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml`), so it applies to every backend module (movie-service, actor-service, api-gateway, config-service, discovery-service, media-service, ai-service, user-service, shared-library) uniformly, not movie-service alone.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `backend-ci.yml` runs `./gradlew sonar` against a real server (SonarCloud free tier or self-hosted), gated on a `SONAR_TOKEN` secret
- [x] A `jacocoTestCoverageVerification` rule enforcing an 80% minimum (line coverage; enterprise-level target set by the project owner) is added to the root `build.gradle`'s shared `jacoco` config and enforced in CI for every backend module
- [x] Modules genuinely below 80% today are identified and either brought up to threshold or given a documented, deliberately-scoped temporary exclusion (not a silent global carve-out)
- [x] DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md's static-analysis and coverage-threshold gates are genuinely satisfiable by a Story going forward

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
**SonarQube target: SonarCloud free tier.** The repo is public so the free tier applies; self-hosting was ruled out because CI runners can't reach a server on this laptop. `sonar.organization` comes from a `SONAR_ORGANIZATION` secret; `sonar.host.url` is hardcoded to `https://sonarcloud.io` in CI. Local runs still use the `localhost:9010` compose profile.

**Manual step still outstanding:** `SONAR_TOKEN` and `SONAR_ORGANIZATION` must be created by signing up at sonarcloud.io and linking the repo. The Sonar CI step skips (does not fail) until then. The coverage gate is live independently.

Coverage exclusions worth knowing: ai-service excludes protoc/gRPC-generated stubs, the same way Sonar already does; config-service and discovery-service are bootstrap-only classes already outside the denominator; media-service has a narrow documented exclusion until Story #94 replaces its placeholder controller.
